base_dir.description: Base directory for storing policy data, databases, and runtime files.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used for process management.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent SMTP connections to accept.

smtp_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for SMTP sessions before they are dropped.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: 0=errors only, 5=debug (includes all protocol traffic).

debug_mode.description: Enable verbose runtime diagnostics (logs full SMTP sessions).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for internal components (e.g., database, inter-service).

ca_bundle_path.description: Path to the CA certificate bundle for verifying TLS connections.

server_cert_path.description: Path to the server certificate (PEM format) used for SMTPS/TLS.

server_key_path.description: Path to the server private key (PEM format) matching the certificate.

path.description: File path for SQLite database (ignored if PostgreSQL is selected).

connection.description: PostgreSQL connection string (e.g., 'host=localhost port=5432 dbname=policy user=mp pass=secret'). Ignored for SQLite.

bind_v4.description: IPv4 address to bind the SMTP listener (use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to localhost).

bind_v6.description: IPv6 address to bind the SMTP listener (empty string disables IPv6).

port.description: Port for the standard SMTP policy service (RFC 6531 §4.1).

smtps_enabled.description: Enable SMTPS (SMTP over TLS on port 465).

smtps_port.description: Port for SMTPS (ignored unless smtps_enabled is true).

limits.description: Rate and resource limits to prevent abuse.

max_recipients.description: Maximum recipients per message (enforced at RCPT TO phase).

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes (25 MiB default).

rate_limit_ppm.description: Rate limit: maximum messages allowed per minute per client IP.

burst_tolerance.description: Extra messages allowed beyond rate_limit_ppm before throttling.

retry_delay.description: Minimum seconds between retries after hitting a limit.

domain_policy_enabled.description: Enable enforcement of domain allow/block lists.

allowed_senders_path.description: Path to a text file listing allowed sender domains (one per line).

blocked_senders_path.description: Path to a text file listing blocked sender domains (one per line).

senders.description: Per-sender policy overrides and rate limits.

sender_policy_enabled.description: Enable per-sender policy enforcement via JSON override files.

sender_overrides_path.description: Path to a JSON file with sender-specific policy overrides.

sender_rate_limits_path.description: Path to a JSON file with per-sender rate limit overrides.

actions.reason: Tor exit nodes are not permitted

policies.description: List of custom policy rules (evaluated in order).

name.description: Unique identifier for the policy rule.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the policy does.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this rule (disabled rules are skipped).

conditions.description: Map of key=value conditions that must all match for the rule to apply.

actions.description: Map of key=value actions to execute if the rule matches.

reason.description: Human-readable rejection or action reason (shown to sender if applicable).
